evidence.V5: Visible faceting on the lower belly curvature (three-quarter) and on the legs (close_leg_studio); bubbles are low-poly spheres with visible flat facets in close_rim_studio

evidence.V7: 1712 tris vs medium target 2000 (ceiling 4000): at or under target
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, kit gold and ink accents and chamfered rim match; minor mismatch from faceted legs/bubbles vs the smooth weighted-normal kit finish, and the default liquid is a dull brown-orange rather than a glowing hue

top_fixes: Add segments or weighted normals to the lower belly, legs and bubbles to remove visible faceting
Brighten/saturate the default ember liquid so it reads as glowing (lighter centre value, warmer emission tone)
Give the ring handles and legs the same ~0.05 stud chamfer as the rim and thicken the rings slightly so they hold at 64 px
